items.mainDefect: test_installation_not_found sends an OAuth state that doesn't match the pipeline signature, so it fails at the state check and never reaches the installation-not-found path it is meant to test.

secondary.defect: The test's assertion was loosened from the specific 'The GitHub installation could not be found.' message to the generic 'Invalid installation request.' error, so it would still pass if not-found handling were broken.
